title: Guard page refresh against unavailable queue renderer
summary: Restored the Queue renderer's module initialization and source-inventory helper boundaries, then removed the brittle global Queue renderer call from page-scoped refreshes.
reason: Metrics refreshes failed with `renderQueue is not defined` because Queue module setup terminated before it exported its renderer.
behavior_before: The Queue view stopped initializing, and a refresh that included queue data threw `renderQueue is not defined`.
behavior_after: Queue initialization completes and page-scoped refreshes call the Queue namespace only when it is available.
manual_validation: Node syntax checks passed for app.js, queueView.js, and queue/sourceRender.js.
Browser-backed large-table smoke progressed past Queue module startup; its unrelated table-scroll assertion still fails.
rollback_plan: Revert the Queue renderer initialization, source-render helper, and page-refresh guard changes in this packet.
notes:
Restore queue module initialization scope so the renderer is exported.
Restore source-inventory rendering helper boundaries.
Avoid a global renderer call during partial page refreshes.
Refresh generated source summary after page-refresh guard.
Refresh generated source summary after queue renderer repair.
Add generated summary for repaired source renderer module.
